title: Re-Volt
shortDescription: Re-Volt helps define a Nintendo 64 racing path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced racing option to the Nintendo 64 discovery path.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Nintendo 64 racing discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
